maintainer.contact: Repository issue / PR tagged task:visa-bound-conference-trip (task-owned hotel fixture, @RuihongY)

capabilities.ui: none; reviewers read reservations through the Agent tools or env.snapshot

limitations: Task-owned fixture for one task; it moves onto a hotel booking environment if one is approved.
One room per booking, one guest, no modification: change a stay by cancelling and booking again.
Rate-switch offers expire, prices change and nights sell out only when Infra applies their events; the App never schedules itself.
Payment labels are opaque; charges and refunds are recorded locally, not posted to a card App. No notices are sent to Mail.
